title: Testimonials
description: A wall of customer quotes, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Button, Card and Skeleton primitives: a serif heading, a sentence of introduction, then one Card per quote with the author's Avatar, name and role, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the quotes read a size larger at @sm, the cards sit in two columns and the heading steps up at @md, and three columns with more room at @lg.
